AUD is eBay's conversion (about 1.94 AUD/GBP, approximate). Same seller's other lots (sold cards): 91-100 A$133.18 (12 Oct, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/237071887315), 101-111 (11 cars) A$151.85 (19 Oct, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/237071951160), 71-80 A$122.00 (28 Sep, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/237071757519), 61-70 A$107.93 (14 Sep, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/237019555581), 51-60 A$77.14 (7 Sep, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/237019509451).

'10 James Bond Cars with Magazines Bundle Job Lot Collection 41 to 50. VGC'. 10 cars with magazines, out of the packs (same seller as above). 3 bids. Listing not opened; price and date from the sold card. GBP figure not seen.

'Eaglemoss James Bond Car Collection 007 Sealed x 12 Casino Royal Goldfinger'. Photo shows 12 cars in sealed display cases, no magazines (not the magazine blister packs). 5 bids. AUD is eBay's conversion. Same seller, same day (sold cards): 'Sealed x 10 Goldeneye Golden Gun' A$67.90, 3 bids (https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/227533834477), and two 'Sealed x 12' lots at A$77.60 each (https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/227533832387, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/227533831663). Postage to Australia was quoted at GBP 64.22 (about A$125).

'The James Bond Car Collection Issue 62 Mercedes S-Class & Magazine Original Pack'. One sealed pack, plus A$12 postage. Same seller sold issue 39 for A$22.46 (2 Nov, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/940052349625) and issue 45 for A$12.00 (8 Oct, https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/278436070413). Single sealed packs sell one at a time in Australia for about A$12-23 each.

'LOTUS ESPRIT #3 007 James Bond Collection DieCast Model - THE SPY WHO...'. Single car, from the sold card, not opened. Shows what one of the wanted models fetches on its own; I could not see a #3 pack in the lot photos.
